sloka: तस्माज्ज्येष्ठे हि कैकेयि राज्यतन्त्राणि पार्थिवाः ।स्थापयन्त्यनवद्याङ्गि गुणवत्स्वतरेष्वपि ॥२-८-२४॥
transliteration: tasmājjyeṣṭhe hi kaikeyi rājyatantrāṇi pārthivāḥ ।sthāpayantyanavadyāṅgi guṇavatsvatareṣvapi ॥2-8-24॥

translations.english: O Kaikeyi of beautiful limbs, for that reason kings bestow the governance of the kingdom either on the eldest or on other virtuous sons.
